run_server_main: run the reverb server executable that starts a server from a textproto configuration file
build_server_from_proto: build reverb server table configurations from a textproto definition using server_from_proto.tables_from_proto
create_server_config_proto: create a server config proto from command-line arguments using server_main_command_line_args.get_server_config_proto
run_server_with_tables: run a reverb server with multiple tables configured from a textproto and specified port
review_app_run_main: review the app_run_main entry point that invokes absl.app.run on the main function
